description: This file defines a React functional component `SearchToolTester` that provides a user interface for testing a search tool. It includes search input, loading states, search results display, result expansion, and search history management.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous search query using the provided search tool, updates search history, and manages loading state.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable locale string.

methods.name: clearHistory
methods.description: Clears the search history and expanded results, and displays a notification.

methods.name: toggleResultExpansion
methods.description: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of a specific search result snippet.
